# PIANO LouvorJA — Developer Wiki

> Public onboarding documentation for the LouvorJA PIANO ecosystem: an app family
> for worship and presentation at the piano. One API (Hono + SQLite) serves three
> clients — desktop Electron, mobile Flutter and web PWA — plus a landing site.
>
> Everything published here is safe, reusable guidance. Internal decisions, active
> plans, ADRs, board automation, infrastructure addresses, deployment
> configuration and credentials are **not** published and live in private
> documentation, which is the source of truth for internal decisions.
>
> Conventions for contributors and coding agents: Conventional Commits, a focused
> pull request, and repository-level gates that must pass before review. Each
> repository's own `AGENTS.md` and contribution guide override anything here.

## Start here

- [Getting started](https://piano-louvor-ja.github.io/wiki/GETTING_STARTED.html): contribution flow and what to read before sharing material
- [Architecture](https://piano-louvor-ja.github.io/wiki/ARCHITECTURE.html): product ecosystem and design principles
- [Contributing](https://piano-louvor-ja.github.io/wiki/CONTRIBUTING.html): expected change shape and pull request checklist

## Working on the code

- [Agent setup](https://piano-louvor-ja.github.io/wiki/AGENT_SETUP.html): repository map, non-negotiable rules, and the traps that are expensive to discover on your own
- [Agent guide](https://piano-louvor-ja.github.io/wiki/AGENTS.html): the rules for agents working with this repository

## Governance and boundaries

- [Governance](https://piano-louvor-ja.github.io/wiki/GOVERNANCE.html): what public documentation may contain, and who decides
- [FAQ](https://piano-louvor-ja.github.io/wiki/FAQ.html): what is public, what is not, how to propose a change

## Templates

- [Specification template](https://piano-louvor-ja.github.io/wiki/SPEC_TEMPLATE.html): blank structure for a specification — problem, outcome, scope, constraints, validation, risks
- [Plan template](https://piano-louvor-ja.github.io/wiki/PLAN_TEMPLATE.html): blank structure for an implementation plan — goal, steps, validation, rollback

## Repository

- [README](https://piano-louvor-ja.github.io/wiki/README.html): overview of this repository and the documents it publishes
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/Piano-Louvor-JA/wiki): the repository these pages are built from
